meta.description: One row per app account and channel.
meta.sql:
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE demo_dwd.dwd_party_account_map_df PARTITION (dt = '${bizdate}')
SELECT account_id, channel_code, MAX(cust_no) AS customer_id, MIN(open_time) AS opened_time
FROM demo_ods.ods_app_account_df
WHERE dt = '${bizdate}'
GROUP BY account_id, channel_code
